manifest.author_role: independent blind-v4 author and final acceptance agent
manifest.author_isolation: Before freezing, the author did not read, search, or import tools/detailed_action_runtime.py, runtime tests, earlier blind fixtures/evidence/reports, or .superpowers/sdd/task-3-* artifacts.
manifest.cases_hash_basis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 (no BOM) LF-joined tab-separated audit rows in file order, terminal LF: id, family, safety_group, probe, instruction, disposition, entry_type, label
principles: Every catalog label has an independently authored, natural oral instruction with explicit operation or use evidence; generic 处理 is forbidden in decidable cases.
All 49 scene labels and all 205 object labels are covered exactly once in the coverage family.

Safety cases cover non-initial cancellation/negation, restrictive negation, double or contrastive negation, word-internal token boundaries, information questions, completed statements, incompatible operations, same-name ambiguity, out-of-domain input, and low confidence.
Every expected rejection forbids all detailed or other action payloads.
Probe cases are natural multi-candidate utterances and declare at least two plausible catalog candidates; the zero-model-weight run is probe-only.
No case copies a complete catalog canonical command or Task-2 train/dev text, under raw or normalized comparison.
After the SHA-256 sidecar is written, this fixture is permanently frozen and must not be edited regardless of observed outcomes.

stage_a_audit.semantic_review: Every case reviewed against catalog object/scene semantics before freeze.
